Name: Lucky Purple Shorts Crop
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Describe the main purpose of your mod[/color][/size]
This mod turns Lewis's lucky purple shorts into a plantable crop! You can buy the seeds at Pierre's shop, grow them in 3 days, and sell them for a profit. It also includes custom keg processing and special NPC gift reactions. A fun and chaotic mod for your Stardew Valley experience!
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Lay out any steps users must follow to install your mod[/color][/size]
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Download this mod and unzip the file.
3. Place the LuckyShortsCrop folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
4. Run the game through SMAPI.
